description:
Filing activity in a Nice class — volume by month and the busiest filers. Signed-in.

    Answers "how crowded is my space" and "who keeps filing near me". Pass a Nice
    class (9, 42, 36…), optionally an office code ('EM', 'US', 'GB', 'CH'), and a
    window in months.

    EVERY COUNT IS OF OUR MIRROR, NOT OF THE OFFICE, and the two differ by a lot for
    some offices right now. Each office carries its own `coverage`, and any office
    whose mirror is behind is named in `do_not_quote`: for those offices a low count
    means filings not yet ingested, not filings that were never made.
name: filing_landscape
title: How busy a class is
